hunks.baseline: The banquet held on New Year’s Day had been such a resounding success that calling it merely a success felt insufficient.
hunks.sol: Calling the banquet held on New Year’s Day a resounding success still felt like an understatement.

hunks.baseline: By embracing the Mount Heng Sword Sect, Jin Wikyung had made a bold move that won the loyalty of dozens of mid- and small-sized sects. The Zhongnan Sect’s intervention and the appearance of Fire King Jeok Cheongang, whom everyone had believed dead, had left them all stunned.
hunks.sol: By embracing the Mount Heng Sword Sect, Jin Wikyung had made a bold move that won the loyalty of dozens of small and mid-sized sects. The Zhongnan Sect’s intervention and the appearance of Fire King Jeok Cheongang, whom everyone had believed dead, had left them all stunned.

hunks.baseline: *I was one of the people left stunned, too.*
hunks.sol: *I was one of them.*

hunks.baseline: I ate, drank, and moved from place to place. Wherever I went, people’s eyes followed my every movement.
hunks.sol: I ate, drank, and moved from place to place. Wherever I went, people’s eyes followed my every move.

hunks.baseline: But not anymore.
hunks.sol: Not anymore.

hunks.baseline: *The Fire King’s Disciple. The Fire Gate Clan’s heir.*
hunks.sol: *The Fire King’s Disciple. The heir to the Fire Gate Clan.*

hunks.baseline: Those words were drifting through the crowd everywhere I went. People were endlessly discussing what it meant that Jeok Cheongang, the current Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan, had entrusted me with the sect’s sacred treasure—and why he had protected the Jin Family of Taiyuan even while making an enemy of the Zhongnan Sect.
hunks.sol: I heard those words everywhere. People talked endlessly about what it meant that Jeok Cheongang, the current Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan, had entrusted me with the sect’s sacred treasure—and why he had protected the Jin Family of Taiyuan even at the cost of making an enemy of the Zhongnan Sect.

hunks.baseline: *It feels like this has already become half-confirmed as fact.*
hunks.sol: *This already seems to be half-confirmed as fact.*

hunks.baseline: And now, while everyone was distracted, I had slipped away. This was my chance.
hunks.sol: Everyone was still distracted, and I had managed to slip away unnoticed. This was my chance.

hunks.baseline: I was standing in front of the pavilion where Jeok Cheongang had been given lodging. No one—not even a mouse—was anywhere near the large pavilion. Someone must have issued orders to keep the area clear.
hunks.sol: I stood before the pavilion where Jeok Cheongang had been given lodging. Someone must have ordered everyone to stay away, because there wasn’t so much as a mouse near the large building.

hunks.baseline: It made no sense, but if the Fire King said that was how it was, then that was how it was. I pulled myself together and spoke again.
hunks.sol: It made no sense, but if the Fire King said that was how it was, then that was how it was. I pulled myself together and tried again.

hunks.baseline: “Um, there’s something I’ve been wondering about no matter how much I think it over.”
hunks.sol: “Um, there’s something I can’t stop wondering about.”

hunks.baseline: “Am I someone who solves your problems for you?”
hunks.sol: “Is this old man responsible for satisfying your curiosity?”

hunks.baseline: Talk about an impenetrable wall.
hunks.sol: Talk about an impenetrable defense.

hunks.baseline: I was cautiously creeping toward the firmly closed door when—
hunks.sol: I began creeping ever so carefully toward the firmly closed door.

hunks.baseline: “To this old man, your presence is no different from the sound of thunder.”
hunks.sol: “To this old man, your presence is no different from a clap of thunder.”

hunks.baseline: “Please don’t be like that. Couldn’t you let me in now? It’s still winter, so it’s rather chilly outside.”
hunks.sol: “Come on. Couldn’t you let me in now? It’s still winter, and it’s rather chilly out here.”

hunks.baseline: “Should this old man warm you up with the Flame Divine Palm?”
hunks.sol: “Would you like this old man to warm you up with the Flame Divine Palm?”

hunks.baseline: Just hearing that made my insides feel hot.
hunks.sol: Just hearing that made my insides feel warm.

hunks.baseline: When I fell silent, silence descended once more. After a while, Jeok Cheongang broke it with a single sentence.
hunks.sol: When I shut my mouth, silence fell. After a while, Jeok Cheongang broke it with a single sentence.

hunks.baseline: Of the dozens of counties and towns in Shanxi Province, Jeongyang was nothing special. But Jeok Cheongang had had a reason to visit a mountain path somewhere there.
hunks.sol: Jeongyang was merely one of the dozens of counties and towns in Shanxi Province, but Jeok Cheongang had a reason to visit a mountain path there.

hunks.baseline: On that day, when the sky had poured down snow, a man who had lived as Jangcheon died under the name Jopil.
hunks.sol: On the day snow came pouring from the sky, a man who had lived as Jangcheon died under the name Jopil.

hunks.baseline: “I told them that a blood relative had died right there. That I had come because I wanted to recover whatever remained of his body.”
hunks.sol: “I told them that a blood relative had died right there. That I had come to recover whatever remained of his body.”

hunks.baseline: “That was when I realized something. Even if I had met that boy before you did, I could never have killed him. I would have let him go again—and regretted it.”
hunks.sol: “That was when I realized something. Even if I had met that boy before you did, I could never have killed him. I would have let him go again, only to regret it afterward.”

hunks.baseline: It was difficult to imagine what expression Jeok Cheongang wore on the other side of the door.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t imagine what expression Jeok Cheongang wore on the other side of the door.

hunks.baseline: After hesitating, I asked:
hunks.sol: After hesitating, I asked, “Did you find his body?”

hunks.baseline: “Did you find the body?”

He had spent his entire life walking a path of blood. The subordinates who might have recovered his body had died with him, too. He had either been buried by the capricious weather or become food for hungry beasts.
hunks.sol: Jopil had spent his entire life walking a path of blood. The subordinates who might have recovered his body had died alongside him, so whatever remained had likely been buried by the capricious weather or devoured by hungry beasts.

hunks.baseline: “It’s an old man’s greed. Ugly and pointless.”
hunks.sol: “It is nothing but an old man’s selfish desire. Ugly and futile.”

hunks.baseline: The sound of liquor filling a cup rang unusually loudly.
hunks.sol: The sound of liquor filling a cup seemed unusually loud.

hunks.baseline: The candlelight filling the pavilion cast his silhouette across the walls.
hunks.sol: The candlelight flooding the pavilion outlined his silhouette.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang let out a quiet laugh, then tipped back his cup.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang let out a quiet laugh, then tossed back his drink.

hunks.baseline: His voice sounded refreshed, as though a single drink had washed away his troubles.
hunks.sol: His voice sounded refreshed, as though that one cup had washed away his troubles.

hunks.baseline: It occurred to me that Jeok Cheongang had gone to the place where Jopil died to shake off the regret and lingering attachment that still held him there.
hunks.sol: It occurred to me that Jeok Cheongang had gone to the place where Jopil died to free himself from the regret and lingering attachment that still held him.

hunks.baseline: I spoke in a deliberately brighter voice.
hunks.sol: I deliberately brightened my voice.

hunks.baseline: “I was taught from a young age that anyone who coveted other people’s things should be burned with the Flame Divine Palm.”
hunks.sol: “I was taught from a young age that anyone who coveted what belonged to others should be burned with the Flame Divine Palm.”

hunks.baseline: That’s the Volcano Gate Clan for you. Ruthless.
hunks.sol: That was the Volcano Gate Clan for you. Ruthless.

hunks.baseline: They burned everyone with the Flame Divine Palm.
hunks.sol: They burned everyone with the Flame Divine Palm, no matter who it was.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know the history of the Fire Gate Clan or the names of its past Sect Leaders, but looking at Jeok Cheongang, I could make a rough guess.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know the history of the Fire Gate Clan or the names of its past Sect Leaders, but looking at Jeok Cheongang gave me a pretty good idea.

hunks.baseline: *An old sect of thugs.*
hunks.sol: *An ancient sect of thugs.*

hunks.baseline: They say beans grow where beans are planted, and red beans where red beans are planted.
hunks.sol: They said beans grew where beans were planted and red beans where red beans were planted.

hunks.baseline: The disciple takes after the master. Jopil was the exception, of course.
hunks.sol: Like master, like disciple. Jopil was the exception, of course.

hunks.baseline: *Anyway, that isn’t why I came here.*
hunks.sol: *Anyway, this isn’t what I came here to talk about.*

hunks.baseline: I was watching the silhouette inside the pavilion while trying to read the situation when Jeok Cheongang suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: I was watching the silent silhouette sip his liquor and trying to gauge his mood when Jeok Cheongang suddenly spoke.

hunks.baseline: I had learned the true name of the Unnamed Sword, but that wasn’t the issue right now. I was so shocked that I even stammered.
hunks.sol: I had just learned the Unnamed Sword’s true name, but that wasn’t the issue right now. I was so shocked that I stammered.

hunks.baseline: “B-but this is the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure.”
hunks.sol: “B-but that’s the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure.”

hunks.baseline: “Ah. The sacred treasure.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, the sacred treasure.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang tilted back yet another cup of liquor and continued.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang tipped back yet another cup of liquor before continuing.

hunks.baseline: “It isn’t a sacred treasure. About a hundred years ago, one of our sect’s Sect Leaders used it. Later generations inherited it from him. It’s old, but it was already famous as a divine weapon back then, so it should still be useful.”
hunks.sol: “It isn’t a sacred treasure. One of our sect’s Sect Leaders used it about a hundred years ago, and later generations inherited it from him. It’s old, but it was already renowned as a divine weapon back then, so it should still be useful.”

hunks.baseline: I stood there with my mouth hanging open at this shocking truth I had never expected.
hunks.sol: I stood there with my mouth hanging open at the shocking revelation.

hunks.baseline: “You said it in front of everyone! ‘I entrusted this boy with the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure!’”
hunks.sol: “You said it in front of everyone! ‘I entrusted that boy with the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure!’”

hunks.baseline: “I did. Because we were in front of everyone.”
hunks.sol: “I did. Because everyone was there.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang continued in a bored voice.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang continued in an indifferent voice.

hunks.baseline: “I had to go that far for people to start talking. ‘That boy must have a deep connection to the Fire King. Since he was entrusted with the sacred treasure, perhaps he is the Fire King’s Disciple. If we provoke the Jin Family of Taiyuan, that terrifying Fire King will step in.’ Rumors like that will spread far and wide.”
hunks.sol: “I had to go that far to get people talking. ‘That boy must have a deep connection to the Fire King. Perhaps he is the Fire King’s Disciple, since he was entrusted with the sacred treasure. If anyone touches the Jin Family of Taiyuan, that terrifying Fire King will step in.’ Rumors like that will spread far and wide.”

hunks.baseline: “Do you really think this old man would entrust our sect’s sacred treasure to a young brat like you? Our arts are passed down to only one successor per generation, so there’s no one else who would know. If I say it’s a sacred treasure, then it’s a sacred treasure.”
hunks.sol: “Do you really think this old man would entrust our sect’s sacred treasure to a young brat like you? Our arts are passed down to only one successor per generation, so no one else knows the truth. If I say it is a sacred treasure, then it is a sacred treasure.”

hunks.baseline: It was the beloved sword of the tenth Sect Leader. No mention of the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure anywhere, no matter how hard I looked.
hunks.sol: It was the beloved sword of the tenth Sect Leader. No matter how hard I looked, there wasn’t a single mention of it being the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure.

hunks.baseline: Even the so-called “true power” hidden within the sword could only be drawn out by someone who had inherited the Fire Gate Clan’s legacy.
hunks.sol: Even the “true power” hidden within the sword could only be drawn out by someone who had inherited the Fire Gate Clan’s legacy.

hunks.baseline: In other words, take away the fact that it was made of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, and the sword was a corpse.
hunks.sol: In other words, other than the fact that it was made of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, the sword was a corpse.

hunks.baseline: *I really thought it was a sacred treasure. I spent so much time worrying about what I’d do if he said he was going to make me a Disciple…*
hunks.sol: *I really thought it was a sacred treasure. I spent so much time worrying about what I’d do if he said he wanted to make me his Disciple…*

hunks.baseline: As I stared blankly at the holographic window, Jeok Cheongang added as though he were doing me a great favor:
hunks.sol: As I stared blankly at the holographic window, Jeok Cheongang added as though he were doing me a great favor.

hunks.baseline: “Damn old man…”
hunks.sol: “Damn old man… Gasp.”

hunks.baseline: “Gasp.”
I had only meant to think that, but it slipped out of my mouth.
hunks.sol: I had only meant to think it, but the words slipped out of my mouth.

hunks.baseline: The moment I clapped my mouth shut in alarm, the firmly closed pavilion door exploded outward.
hunks.sol: I clapped my mouth shut in alarm. At that very moment, the firmly closed pavilion door burst outward.

hunks.baseline: A pair of eyes burning with flames glared at me.
hunks.sol: A pair of eyes blazing with fire glared at me.

hunks.baseline: A palm glowing red-hot. An overwhelming wave of heat.
hunks.sol: A palm glowed red-hot, radiating overwhelming heat.

hunks.baseline: I turned around without even looking back. In the same instant, I pulled the Flame Divine Palm manual from my Inventory and threw it.
hunks.sol: I spun around without looking back. In the same instant, I pulled the Flame Divine Palm manual from my Inventory and threw it.

hunks.baseline: “Gasp! The manual—the Flame Divine Palm manual!”
hunks.sol: “Gasp! The manual! The Flame Divine Palm manual!”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang, startled, hastily pulled back his fist. I took advantage of the opening and ran with all my might.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang recoiled in alarm and hastily pulled back his fist. I seized the opening and ran for my life.

hunks.baseline: His roar rang out thunderously behind me.
hunks.sol: His roar thundered behind me.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang watched Jin Taekyung’s back as he fled as though his tail were on fire and let out a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang watched Jin Taekyung flee as though his tail were on fire and let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: “You little fool. No matter how far you run, you’re still in the palm of this old man’s hand.”
hunks.sol: “You little fool. No matter how far you run, you are still in the palm of this old man’s hand.”

hunks.baseline: If he wanted to catch him, he could do so at any time.
hunks.sol: He could catch Taekyung whenever he wished.

hunks.baseline: But Jeok Cheongang merely clasped his hands behind his back and turned around.
hunks.sol: But Jeok Cheongang merely clasped his hands behind his back and turned away.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung was the man who had killed Jangcheon, the Disciple Jeok Cheongang had cherished like a son.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung had killed Jangcheon, the Disciple Jeok Cheongang had cherished like a son.

hunks.baseline: Yet Jeok Cheongang did not hate him.
hunks.sol: Yet Jeok Cheongang bore him no hatred.

hunks.baseline: If anything, Taekyung was one of the people to whom Jeok Cheongang truly owed an apology.
hunks.sol: If anything, Taekyung was one of the people to whom Jeok Cheongang owed a sincere apology.

hunks.baseline: Everything had begun with a wrong choice he had made ten years ago.
hunks.sol: Everything had begun with the wrong choice Jeok Cheongang had made ten years ago.

hunks.baseline: Despite being cursed out by a young pup, Jeok Cheongang did not feel bad.
hunks.sol: Despite being cursed by a little pup, Jeok Cheongang wasn’t offended.

hunks.baseline: No—in fact, he felt refreshed.
hunks.sol: No, if anything, he felt relieved.

hunks.baseline: “That’s right. I am a damn old man. A senile old man, too. Heh heh. Heh heh heh.”
hunks.sol: “That’s right. I am a damn old man. A senile old fool, too. Heh heh. Heh heh heh.”

hunks.baseline: He was the Fire King. A great martial artist who had written his own legend.
hunks.sol: He was the Fire King, a great martial artist who had single-handedly written himself into legend.

hunks.baseline: And yet, hearing that one remark from Jin Taekyung made him feel as though something that had been blocked for a long time had suddenly burst open.
hunks.sol: Yet hearing those words from Jin Taekyung made him feel as though something that had been blocked for years had finally burst open.

hunks.baseline: “It feels good. So good.”
hunks.sol: “How refreshing. Truly refreshing.”

hunks.baseline: As people grow older, they become lonelier day by day. Not because they have no one with whom to share their warmth, but because they have no one to lean on.
hunks.sol: As people grew older, they became lonelier by the day. Not because they had no one beside them, but because they had no one to lean on.

hunks.baseline: A person might serve as someone else’s support, but Jeok Cheongang had grown too old to lean on anyone himself.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang could serve as someone else’s support, but he had grown too old to lean on anyone himself.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang was a rough, sharp thorn tree. He had lived a long life and crossed paths with countless people, but he had never allowed any of them to lean on him.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang was a rough, sharp thorn tree. He had lived a long life and crossed paths with countless people, but he had never allowed anyone to lean on him.

hunks.baseline: As Jeok Cheongang thought of him, his eyes grew clouded. But his chest did not hurt as much as it once had, nor did his eyes grow hot.
hunks.sol: As Jeok Cheongang thought of him, his gaze clouded over. But his chest no longer hurt as much as it once had, nor did his eyes grow hot.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang had drunk a bottle of liquor at the place where his Disciple had fallen after spilling his blood, then poured out an entire crockful.
hunks.sol: At the place where his Disciple had fallen in a spray of blood, Jeok Cheongang had drunk a bottle of liquor and poured out an entire crockful.

hunks.baseline: If there was a next time, that belonged to the next life.
hunks.sol: If there was to be a next time, it would be in the next life.

hunks.baseline: After wandering around the courtyard for a long while, Jeok Cheongang suddenly stopped.
hunks.sol: After pacing around the courtyard for a long while, Jeok Cheongang suddenly stopped.

hunks.baseline: The image of Jangcheon that had been flickering before his eyes vanished, replaced by someone he had never expected to think of.
hunks.sol: Jangcheon’s face vanished from before his eyes, replaced by someone he had never expected to think of.

hunks.baseline: Clear-cut features. A confident smile that was somehow irritating.
hunks.sol: Open, well-defined features. A confident smile that somehow managed to be irritating.

hunks.baseline: And the way he cautiously gauged Jeok Cheongang’s mood while still taking all of his sharp remarks in stride.
hunks.sol: The way he cautiously gauged Jeok Cheongang’s mood, yet still took every cutting remark in stride.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang was frowning when—
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang frowned.

hunks.baseline: The sound of something burning filled the air, followed by a thin trail of smoke.
hunks.sol: Something began to burn, sending up a thin trail of smoke.

hunks.baseline: Realizing where the sound had come from, he opened his eyes wide.
hunks.sol: Realizing where the sound had come from, his eyes flew open.

hunks.baseline: The cover of the Flame Divine Palm manual was already half-burned.
hunks.sol: The cover of the Flame Divine Palm manual had already burned halfway through.

hunks.baseline: “Jin Taekyung! You damned bastard!”
hunks.sol: “Jin Taekyung! You bastard! I’ll kill you!”
